description: Unofficial Don Quixote fan-art companion in her LCB default appearance from Limbus Company. Original routines include comparing rounded toy badges, a courteous toe-rise and bow, catching a rolling badge, eager tie adjustment and polishing a closed shoe on a low foam block. Uniform layers are preserved, while shoe details and badges are simplified without readable branding. No lance, weapon action or transformation appears.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
